page_title: GET 1-1 ALA | Getafe v Alaves 24/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Alejandro Quintero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
90+3' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Eduardo Coudet, then shows him a yellow.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
88' The game has begun to heat up. Davinchi (Getafe) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
88' That will be all from Yusi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Victor Parada (Alaves).
86' Luis Milla (Getafe) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for an infringement.
83' The substitution has been made. Coba da Costa (Getafe) has replaced Borja Mayoral.
82' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
79' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Davinchi (Getafe) replaces Diego Rico.
78' Eduardo Coudet decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carles Alena (Alaves) is coming onto the pitch as Toni Martinez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' A substitution has been made. Mariano Diaz is replaced by Lucas Boye (Alaves).
78' Facundo Garces (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' 6:9 – the total goal attempt statistics.
76' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Luis Milla (Getafe), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

75' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
72' The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
71' 1 - 1 Goal! Ander Guevara (Alaves) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:1.
71' Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
70' Djene (Getafe) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

69' Toni Martinez (Alaves) didn't hesitate to shoot from around the penalty spot and aimed towards the bottom right corner. David Soria was alert, made a superb save and parried the ball onto the post.
66' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is about to take a corner kick.

63' 1 - 0 Goal! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the middle of the net. Antonio Sivera is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
63' Luis Milla (Getafe) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
61' Substitution. Mario Martin is replaced by Javier Munoz (Getafe).
60' It looks like Yusi (Alaves) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Quintero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
57' Alaves fail to score from a corner as David Soria (Getafe) leaps to collect the ball.
55' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
54' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Mariano Diaz (Alaves), who has already been caught several times today.
49' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Handball! A player from Alaves handled the ball.
46' Half-time substitution. Calebe is replaced by Carlos Vicente (Alaves).
46' Half-time substitution. Jose Bordalas Jimenez decided to make a change. Abu Kamara is replaced by Alex Sancris (Getafe).
46' Referee Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Mario Martin (Getafe) is able to continue to play.
42' Mario Martin (Getafe) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
40' Calebe (Alaves) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
39' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.

39' David Soria was forced into action to thwart Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot towards the roof of the net but couldn't beat the keeper.
34' 1:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
31' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Abdel Abqar (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
28' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' Kiko Femenia (Getafe) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
27' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will deliver the corner kick.

26' What a poor attempt! Mariano Diaz (Alaves) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
24' The linesman raises his flag. Kiko Femenia (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
23' Alaves have a corner.
21' Calebe (Alaves) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
20' Diego Rico (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' Mariano Diaz (Alaves) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. David Soria sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
15' The flag is raised and Mariano Diaz (Alaves) is offside again, not for the first time today.
13' Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mauro Arambarri (Getafe).
10' Diego Rico (Getafe) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
10' Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game. One of the players from Alaves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
9' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' A pass from Abu Kamara (Getafe) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
5' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
4' Abu Kamara (Getafe) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' The game is interrupted as Mariano Diaz (Alaves) is flagged offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Alejandro Quintero.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
